# pai uhp

Serve PAI workers over the Unified Harness Protocol

```
pai uhp <command>
```

PAI as a UHP server: discovery, harness and model listing for the enabled provider/class pairs, bearer-token auth. See docs/uhp.md.

```sh
pai uhp token create
pai uhp serve
```

### pai uhp serve

Serve the UHP API (discovery, harnesses, models)

```
pai uhp serve [options]
```

Starts the UHP HTTP server. GET /v1/uhp is open; every other endpoint needs a bearer token from `pai uhp token create`. Binds loopback by default; a non-loopback bind needs --allow-remote and at least one token, and TLS must be terminated in front.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--port N` | number | 8791 | Port (0 picks a free one) |
| `--bind ADDR` | string | 127.0.0.1 | Address to bind |
| `--allow-remote` | flag | — | Permit a non-loopback --bind (requires tokens) |
| `--tokens FILE` | string | — | Tokens file (default: <PAI_HOME>/uhp/tokens.json) |

```sh
pai uhp serve
pai uhp serve --port 0
pai uhp serve --bind 0.0.0.0 --allow-remote
```

### pai uhp token

Manage UHP bearer tokens

```
pai uhp token <command>
```

Tokens are stored as sha256 hashes in <PAI_HOME>/uhp/tokens.json.

```sh
pai uhp token create
pai uhp token list
pai uhp token revoke tok_1a2b3c4d
```

#### pai uhp token create

Create a bearer token (shown once)

```
pai uhp token create [options]
```

Stores the sha256 of a new token; the plaintext is printed once. --scope limits the token to the named harness ids; --tenant binds it to a tenant (its rules directory and audit log).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--label TEXT` | string | — | Free-text label |
| `--scope ID,ID` | string | — | Harness ids the token may see (default: all) |
| `--tenant NAME` | string | — | Tenant whose rules and audit log the token's decisions use (default: local) |
| `--tokens FILE` | string | — | Tokens file (default: <PAI_HOME>/uhp/tokens.json) |

```sh
pai uhp token create --label ci
```

#### pai uhp token revoke

Revoke a token (takes effect on the next request)

```
pai uhp token revoke ID [options]
```

Marks the token revoked; a revoked token is refused like an unknown one.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ID` | yes | Token id from `pai uhp token list` |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--tokens FILE` | string | — | Tokens file (default: <PAI_HOME>/uhp/tokens.json) |

```sh
pai uhp token revoke tok_1a2b3c4d
```

#### pai uhp token list

List tokens (ids and hash prefixes, never the secret)

```
pai uhp token list [options]
```

Shows id, state, label, scope and a short hash prefix per token.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--tokens FILE` | string | — | Tokens file (default: <PAI_HOME>/uhp/tokens.json) |

```sh
pai uhp token list
```
